content: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs), particularly finerenone, have demonstrated significant efficacy in slowing the progression of kidney disease and reducing cardiovascular events in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) who also have type 2 diabetes (T2D). These benefits are especially notable in individuals with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 73 m² and significant albuminuria.
